notes: Everyday American meals for US users of the weekly planner. One adult serving per recipe; quantities are grams so nutrition resolves from food references. Import with --partial after a --dry-run review.

recipes.name: Veggie Scrambled Eggs with Whole-Wheat Toast
recipes.description: Soft scrambled eggs with spinach and bell pepper, served with whole-wheat toast.

steps.title: Prep
steps.description: Dice the bell pepper and roughly chop the spinach.

steps.title: Cook vegetables
steps.description: Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and cook the pepper for 2 minutes, then add the spinach until wilted.

steps.title: Scramble
steps.description: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt, pour into the pan and stir gently until just set.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Toast the bread and serve with the eggs.

recipes.name: Oatmeal with Blueberries and Walnuts
recipes.description: Creamy rolled oats cooked in milk and topped with blueberries, walnuts and a little honey.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.description: Bring the milk to a gentle simmer, stir in the oats and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often.

steps.title: Top
steps.description: Spoon into a bowl and top with blueberries, chopped walnuts and honey.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait with Granola and Strawberries
recipes.description: Layers of plain Greek yogurt, sliced strawberries and crunchy granola.

steps.title: Slice
steps.description: Hull and slice the strawberries.

steps.title: Layer
steps.description: Layer half the yogurt, half the strawberries and half the granola, then repeat.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Drizzle with honey and eat right away so the granola stays crisp.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with a Fried Egg
recipes.description: Whole-wheat toast with mashed avocado, cherry tomatoes and a fried egg.

steps.title: Mash
steps.description: Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Fry
steps.description: Fry the egg in the olive oil until the white is set.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Toast the bread, spread with avocado, add halved tomatoes and top with the egg.

recipes.name: Spinach and Cheddar Omelet
recipes.description: A three-egg omelet filled with spinach and cheddar, with a slice of whole-wheat toast.

steps.title: Wilt spinach
steps.description: Melt half the butter in a skillet and wilt the spinach; set aside.

steps.title: Cook eggs
steps.description: Whisk the eggs, add the remaining butter to the pan and pour in the eggs, pulling the edges in as they set.

steps.title: Fill
steps.description: Scatter spinach and cheddar over one half, fold and cook 1 minute more.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Serve with the toast.

recipes.name: Egg and Black Bean Breakfast Burrito
recipes.description: Scrambled eggs, black beans, cheddar and salsa wrapped in a flour tortilla.

steps.title: Warm beans
steps.description: Rinse the beans and warm them in the oiled skillet for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Scramble
steps.description: Add the whisked eggs and stir until just set.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.description: Warm the tortilla, fill with eggs, beans, cheddar and salsa, then roll up tightly.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
recipes.description: Whole-wheat toast spread with peanut butter and topped with banana and cinnamon.

steps.title: Toast
steps.description: Toast the bread.

steps.title: Top
steps.description: Spread with peanut butter, add banana slices and dust with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Apple Cinnamon Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Oats soaked overnight in milk and yogurt with apple, chia and cinnamon.

steps.title: Mix
steps.description: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia, maple syrup and cinnamon together in a jar.

steps.title: Chill
steps.description: Cover and refrigerate overnight, or at least 4 hours.

steps.title: Top
steps.description: Dice the apple and stir it in before eating.

recipes.name: Whole-Grain Blueberry Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy whole-wheat pancakes studded with blueberries and a drizzle of maple syrup.

steps.title: Mix batter
steps.description: Whisk the flour and baking powder, then stir in the egg, milk and oil until just combined.

steps.title: Cook
steps.description: Pour small rounds onto a hot greased griddle, scatter with blueberries and flip when bubbles form.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Serve warm with maple syrup.

recipes.name: Turkey Sausage and Egg English Muffin
recipes.description: A toasted whole-wheat English muffin with an egg, a turkey sausage patty and cheddar.

steps.title: Cook sausage
steps.description: Brown the turkey sausage patty for 3 to 4 minutes per side until cooked through.

steps.title: Cook egg
steps.description: Fry the egg in the same pan, breaking the yolk so it cooks evenly.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Toast the muffin and stack the sausage, egg and cheddar inside.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Peaches and Almonds
recipes.description: Low-fat cottage cheese topped with sliced peaches, almonds and honey.

steps.title: Slice
steps.description: Slice the peaches.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl and top with peaches, chopped almonds and honey.

recipes.name: Veggie Egg Muffin Cups
recipes.description: Baked egg cups with peppers, onion, spinach and cheddar, great for busy mornings.

steps.title: Prep
steps.description: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and oil 4 muffin cups.

steps.title: Fill
steps.description: Divide the diced vegetables and cheese between the cups.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Pour in the whisked, seasoned eggs and bake 18 to 20 minutes until set.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash with Eggs
recipes.description: Crispy sweet potato, onion and pepper hash topped with two eggs.

steps.title: Cook potato
steps.description: Dice the sweet potato and cook in the oil over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.

steps.title: Add vegetables
steps.description: Add the diced onion, pepper and paprika and cook 5 minutes more.

steps.title: Add eggs
steps.description: Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until the whites are set.

recipes.name: Whole-Wheat Bagel with Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese
recipes.description: A toasted whole-wheat bagel with cream cheese, smoked salmon, cucumber and red onion.

steps.title: Toast
steps.description: Split and toast the bagel.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Spread with cream cheese and top with smoked salmon, thin cucumber slices and red onion.

recipes.name: Egg and Pepper Breakfast Quesadilla
recipes.description: Scrambled eggs, peppers and melted cheese crisped in a whole-wheat tortilla.

steps.title: Scramble
steps.description: Soften the diced pepper in the oil, add the eggs and scramble until just set.

steps.title: Fill
steps.description: Spread the eggs and cheese over half the tortilla and fold.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.description: Cook the quesadilla 2 minutes per side until golden; serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Turkey Avocado Sandwich with Baby Carrots
recipes.description: Sliced turkey, avocado, lettuce and tomato on whole-wheat bread, with baby carrots on the side.

steps.title: Spread
steps.description: Mash the avocado onto one slice of bread and spread mustard on the other.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Layer the turkey, lettuce and tomato, close and cut in half.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Pack or serve with the baby carrots.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Crisp romaine with grilled chicken, parmesan, croutons and Caesar dressing.

steps.title: Grill chicken
steps.description: Rub the chicken with oil, salt and pepper and grill 5 to 6 minutes per side until cooked through; rest and slice.

steps.title: Toss
steps.description: Chop the romaine and toss with the dressing and half the parmesan.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Top with chicken, croutons and the remaining parmesan.

recipes.name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
recipes.description: Brown rice topped with seasoned chicken, black beans, corn, salsa, lettuce and avocado.

steps.title: Cook chicken
steps.description: Season the chicken with chili powder and salt, then cook in the oil 6 minutes per side; slice.

steps.title: Warm
steps.description: Warm the rice, beans and corn.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Fill a bowl with rice and top with chicken, beans, corn, lettuce, salsa and avocado; squeeze over the lime.

recipes.name: Tuna Salad Wrap
recipes.description: Light tuna salad with celery, lettuce and tomato rolled in a whole-wheat tortilla.

steps.title: Mix
steps.description: Flake the tuna and mix with mayonnaise and finely diced celery.

steps.title: Fill
steps.description: Spread over the tortilla and top with lettuce and sliced tomato.

steps.title: Roll
steps.description: Roll up tightly and cut in half.

recipes.name: Black Bean Soup
recipes.description: A hearty, smoky black bean soup finished with a spoon of Greek yogurt.

steps.title: Soften
steps.description: Cook the diced onion, carrot and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.description: Add the beans, broth and cumin and simmer 15 minutes.

steps.title: Blend
steps.description: Blend about half the soup and stir it back in for a creamy texture.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Top with Greek yogurt.

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Classic chicken noodle soup with carrots, celery and egg noodles.

steps.title: Soften
steps.description: Cook the diced onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Poach
steps.description: Add the broth and chicken and simmer 15 minutes; remove and shred the chicken.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.description: Add the noodles and cook until tender, then return the chicken and season.

recipes.name: Cobb Salad
recipes.description: Romaine with chicken, hard-boiled egg, bacon, avocado, tomato and blue cheese.

steps.title: Boil egg
steps.description: Boil the egg for 10 minutes, cool and chop.

steps.title: Crisp bacon
steps.description: Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble.

steps.title: Arrange
steps.description: Arrange rows of chicken, egg, bacon, avocado, tomato and blue cheese over the lettuce and drizzle with vinaigrette.

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese with Tomato Soup
recipes.description: A golden whole-wheat grilled cheese sandwich with a bowl of tomato soup.

steps.title: Heat soup
steps.description: Warm the tomato soup in a saucepan.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Butter the outsides of the bread and fill with cheddar.

steps.title: Grill
steps.description: Cook over medium heat 3 minutes per side until golden and melted; serve with the soup.

recipes.name: Turkey and Bean Chili
recipes.description: Lean ground turkey chili with kidney beans, tomatoes and peppers.

steps.title: Brown
steps.description: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil for 4 minutes, then add the turkey and brown it.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.description: Stir in the chili powder, tomatoes and beans and simmer 20 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Top with a little cheddar.

recipes.name: Quinoa Chickpea Bowl with Hummus
recipes.description: Quinoa with chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, spinach, feta and a lemon dressing.

steps.title: Dress
steps.description: Whisk the olive oil and lemon juice with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Combine
steps.description: Toss the quinoa, chickpeas, spinach, diced cucumber and halved tomatoes with the dressing.

steps.title: Top
steps.description: Finish with hummus and crumbled feta.

recipes.name: Chicken Quesadilla with Peppers
recipes.description: A crisp whole-wheat quesadilla with chicken, peppers, onion and melted cheese.

steps.title: Soften
steps.description: Cook the sliced pepper and onion in the oil for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Fill
steps.description: Layer the cheese, chicken and vegetables on half the tortilla and fold.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.description: Cook 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden; serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Lentil Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: A thick lentil soup with carrots, celery and tomatoes.

steps.title: Soften
steps.description: Cook the diced onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.description: Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes and broth and simmer 25 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Season
steps.description: Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: BLT Sandwich
recipes.description: Crisp bacon, lettuce and tomato with light mayo on whole-wheat toast.

steps.title: Cook bacon
steps.description: Cook the bacon until crisp and drain on paper towels.

steps.title: Toast
steps.description: Toast the bread and spread with mayonnaise.

steps.title: Stack
steps.description: Layer lettuce, tomato and bacon, close and slice.

recipes.name: Veggie Hummus Wrap
recipes.description: Hummus, crunchy vegetables, spinach and feta in a whole-wheat tortilla.

steps.title: Spread
steps.description: Spread the hummus over the tortilla.

steps.title: Fill
steps.description: Add spinach, sliced cucumber, pepper, grated carrot and feta.

steps.title: Roll
steps.description: Roll tightly and cut in half.

recipes.name: Egg Salad Sandwich
recipes.description: Creamy egg salad with celery and mustard on whole-wheat bread.

steps.title: Boil
steps.description: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.

steps.title: Mix
steps.description: Chop the eggs and mix with mayonnaise, mustard and finely diced celery.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Spread on the bread with lettuce.

recipes.name: Baked Salmon with Roasted Broccoli and Brown Rice
recipes.description: Lemon-garlic baked salmon with roasted broccoli and brown rice.

steps.title: Heat oven
steps.description: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).

steps.title: Roast
steps.description: Toss the broccoli with half the oil and roast 10 minutes.

steps.title: Bake salmon
steps.description: Add the salmon, brushed with the remaining oil, garlic and lemon, and bake 12 minutes more.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Serve with warm brown rice.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken with Sweet Potato and Green Beans
recipes.description: Herb-grilled chicken breast with a baked sweet potato and garlicky green beans.

steps.title: Bake potato
steps.description: Prick the sweet potato and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 30 minutes, or microwave 6 to 8 minutes.

steps.title: Grill
steps.description: Season the chicken and grill 5 to 6 minutes per side until cooked through.

steps.title: Beans
steps.description: Sauté the green beans with the garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Turkey Meatballs with Whole-Wheat Spaghetti
recipes.description: Baked turkey meatballs in marinara over whole-wheat spaghetti.

steps.title: Shape
steps.description: Mix the turkey, egg, breadcrumbs, garlic and half the parmesan and roll into 6 meatballs.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 18 minutes.

steps.title: Pasta
steps.description: Cook the spaghetti; warm the marinara and add the meatballs.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Serve over pasta with the remaining parmesan.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
recipes.description: Chicken, peppers and onion roasted with fajita spices, served in warm corn tortillas.

steps.title: Toss
steps.description: Slice the chicken, peppers and onion and toss with the oil and spices.

steps.title: Roast
steps.description: Roast at 425°F (220°C) for 18 to 20 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Squeeze over the lime and serve in warm tortillas with Greek yogurt.

recipes.name: Shrimp Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
recipes.description: Chili-lime shrimp in corn tortillas with a crunchy cabbage slaw and avocado.

steps.title: Slaw
steps.description: Toss the shredded cabbage with the yogurt, half the lime juice and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Cook shrimp
steps.description: Season the shrimp with chili powder and cook in the oil 2 minutes per side; add the remaining lime.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Fill warm tortillas with shrimp, slaw and sliced avocado.

recipes.name: Lean Beef Burger with Side Salad
recipes.description: A lean beef burger on a whole-wheat bun with lettuce and tomato and a simple green salad.

steps.title: Shape
steps.description: Season the beef and shape into a patty slightly wider than the bun.

steps.title: Cook
steps.description: Cook 4 minutes per side, adding the cheddar for the last minute.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Build the burger on the toasted bun with lettuce, tomato and onion; toss the greens with vinaigrette on the side.

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Takeout-style beef and broccoli in a garlic-ginger soy sauce over brown rice.

steps.title: Slice
steps.description: Thinly slice the beef across the grain and toss with half the cornstarch.

steps.title: Sear
steps.description: Stir-fry the beef in hot oil for 2 minutes and remove.

steps.title: Broccoli
steps.description: Stir-fry the broccoli with garlic and ginger for 3 minutes with a splash of water.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.description: Return the beef, add soy sauce mixed with the remaining cornstarch and 3 tbsp water, and toss until glossy; serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Mashed Potatoes and Green Beans
recipes.description: Pan-seared pork chops with creamy mashed potatoes and green beans.

steps.title: Potatoes
steps.description: Boil the peeled, cubed potatoes 15 minutes, drain and mash with milk and butter.

steps.title: Sear
steps.description: Season the chops and sear in the oil 4 to 5 minutes per side until 145°F (63°C) inside; rest 3 minutes.

steps.title: Beans
steps.description: Steam or sauté the green beans and serve everything together.

recipes.name: Turkey Meatloaf with Roasted Carrots
recipes.description: A tender turkey meatloaf glazed with ketchup, served with roasted carrots.

steps.title: Mix
steps.description: Mix the turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, grated onion and half the ketchup and shape into a small loaf.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Brush with the remaining ketchup and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 35 to 40 minutes.

steps.title: Carrots
steps.description: Toss the carrots with the oil and roast on the same oven rack for the last 25 minutes.

recipes.name: BBQ Chicken with Corn on the Cob and Coleslaw
recipes.description: Barbecue-glazed chicken thighs with sweet corn and a creamy coleslaw.

steps.title: Slaw
steps.description: Toss the shredded cabbage and carrot with mayonnaise and vinegar; chill.

steps.title: Cook chicken
steps.description: Grill or bake the chicken at 425°F (220°C) for 20 minutes, brushing with barbecue sauce for the last 5.

steps.title: Corn
steps.description: Boil or grill the corn for 8 minutes and serve with the chicken and slaw.

recipes.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Beef and Rice
recipes.description: Bell peppers filled with lean beef, brown rice and tomatoes, topped with cheddar.

steps.title: Filling
steps.description: Brown the beef with the onion, then stir in the rice and tomatoes.

steps.title: Stuff
steps.description: Halve and seed the peppers and pack them with the filling.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Cover and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30 minutes, add the cheddar and bake 5 minutes more.

recipes.name: Baked Cod with Quinoa and Asparagus
recipes.description: Paprika-lemon baked cod with fluffy quinoa and roasted asparagus.

steps.title: Heat oven
steps.description: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).

steps.title: Season
steps.description: Lay the cod and asparagus on a sheet pan and brush with oil, garlic, lemon and paprika.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Bake 12 to 15 minutes until the fish flakes; serve over quinoa.

recipes.name: Black Bean and Spinach Enchiladas
recipes.description: Corn tortillas rolled around black beans and spinach, baked in enchilada sauce with cheese.

steps.title: Filling
steps.description: Warm the beans with the diced onion and spinach until wilted.

steps.title: Roll
steps.description: Fill and roll the tortillas and lay them seam-side down in a dish with half the sauce.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Top with the rest of the sauce and the cheese and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes; serve with yogurt.

recipes.name: Roast Chicken Thighs with Potatoes and Carrots
recipes.description: One-pan rosemary chicken thighs roasted with potatoes and carrots.

steps.title: Toss
steps.description: Cut the potatoes and carrots into chunks and toss with oil, garlic, rosemary and salt.

steps.title: Roast
steps.description: Roast at 425°F (220°C) for 15 minutes, add the seasoned chicken and roast 25 minutes more until cooked through.

recipes.name: Sirloin Steak with Baked Potato and Asparagus
recipes.description: Pan-seared sirloin with a baked potato topped with Greek yogurt and roasted asparagus.

steps.title: Bake potato
steps.description: Bake the potato at 425°F (220°C) for 45 minutes, adding the oiled asparagus for the last 12.

steps.title: Sear
steps.description: Season the steak and sear in a hot pan 3 to 4 minutes per side; rest 5 minutes with the butter on top.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Split the potato, top with Greek yogurt and serve with the sliced steak and asparagus.

recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi with Whole-Wheat Linguine
recipes.description: Garlic-lemon shrimp tossed with whole-wheat linguine and spinach.

steps.title: Pasta
steps.description: Cook the linguine and save a splash of the water.

steps.title: Shrimp
steps.description: Cook the garlic in the oil and butter for 1 minute, add the shrimp and cook 3 minutes.

steps.title: Toss
steps.description: Add the spinach, lemon juice, pasta and pasta water and toss; finish with parmesan.

recipes.name: Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Crispy tofu with broccoli, peppers and carrots in a soy-ginger sauce over brown rice.

steps.title: Crisp tofu
steps.description: Press and cube the tofu, then fry in half the oil until golden; set aside.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.description: Stir-fry the vegetables with garlic and ginger in the remaining oil for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Return the tofu, add the soy sauce and toss; serve over rice.

recipes.name: Whole-Wheat Pasta Primavera
recipes.description: Whole-wheat pasta with zucchini, cherry tomatoes and broccoli in garlic olive oil.

steps.title: Pasta
steps.description: Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes; drain.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.description: Sauté the zucchini and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes, then add the tomatoes until they soften.

steps.title: Toss
steps.description: Toss with the pasta and broccoli and finish with parmesan.

recipes.name: Three-Bean Vegetarian Chili
recipes.description: A hearty chili with black, kidney and pinto beans, peppers and tomatoes.

steps.title: Soften
steps.description: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.description: Add the chili powder, beans and tomatoes with a splash of water and simmer 25 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Top with Greek yogurt.
